findings.summary: The reporter route callback is currently dead configuration.
findings.consequence: Keeping this callback suggests browser events preserve route context, but the current browser reporter compact payload never reads ReporterOptions.route and server intake reconstructs browser events with route set to null, so removing this line would not change delivered observability data.
findings.evidence: Line 30 passes route: () => router.currentRoute.value.matched.at(-1)?.path ?? null. The imported BrowserObservabilityReporter.capture path builds only event_id, event_name, error_type, resource_kind, and correlation_token, and server/utils/observability-intake.ts trustedBrowserEvent sets route: null for accepted browser intake events.
findings.recommendation: Delete the route option from this plugin and ReporterOptions if compact browser intake intentionally omits routes, or add an explicit sanitized route field to the compact intake contract and tests if browser route attribution is required.
